hooks.name: Secret exorcist before writes
hooks.description: Before the agent writes files, re-inject the data-hygiene rules so no secrets, real IPs or customer names enter the repo.

action.prompt: Before writing: confirm the content contains no passwords, SNMP communities, pre-shared keys, real public IPs (outside RFC 5737), or real company/host names. Follow .kiro/steering/security.md. If any are present, redact with <redacted> first.
